data.one_liner: Provides screen lock and passcode protection functionality with optional biometrics.
data.what_it_does: Provides a screen lock widget and functions to require a passcode (PIN) or biometric authentication from the user. Supports passcode creation, confirmation workflows, landscape view, physical keyboard input, and full visual customization.
use_when: You need to protect sensitive areas of your mobile or desktop app with a passcode.
You want to combine passcode entry with biometric authentication.
avoid_when: You are handling backend user sign-in and session management (which requires an authentication client).
You only need local biometric prompting without a custom keypad UI.
strengths: Supports custom themes, custom widget builders, and localized keypad buttons.
Handles physical keyboard input for desktop and tablet devices.
Supports passcode creation and confirmation out of the box.
weaknesses: Requires integrating a separate package like local_auth for biometric functionality.
data.setup_notes: Add the package to pubspec.yaml. To use biometrics, integrate the local_auth package.

alternatives.name: local_auth
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need standard OS-level biometric prompts rather than a full passcode screen lock interface.
